user.title: Connect to Dahua ARC
user.description: Connect locally to a Dahua ARC alarm hub. In normal operation the integration only reads from the hub: it discovers the ARC hub, paired radio devices, MultiIO wired inputs, wireless sensors, sirens, repeaters, keyfobs/keypads, alarm-related configuration and realtime alarm-input state. It never arms, disarms or triggers outputs.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Dahua ARC hub.
data_description.password: Password of a local ARC user. It is stored in Home Assistant and never shown again.

behavior.title: Dahua ARC behavior
behavior.description: Choose the authoritative safety reconciliation interval and optionally let Dahua ARC intelligently place location-bearing alarm entities into existing Home Assistant areas.

data.auto_area_match: Smartly assign devices and sensors to Home Assistant areas

data_description.periodic_resync_seconds: A local DHIP snapshot verifies current AlarmIn states if a realtime event was missed. 300 seconds is recommended.
data_description.auto_area_match: Uses Dahua AlarmSubSystem room assignments first, then local sensor names, and matches them against your existing Home Assistant area names and aliases. Ambiguous matches are skipped.
data_description.enable_research_features: Off by default. Enables the experimental PIRCam snapshot camera, LowRateWPAN polling/subscription diagnostics and PIRCam detector-test buttons. The detector-test buttons are the only feature that writes to the ARC (they toggle a PIR camera's sensitivity test). Leave disabled for production wired-zone operation.

area_match.title: Smart area matching
area_match.description: Choose which Home Assistant areas are eligible. Dahua's own subsystem/area assignment is preferred when available; sensor names, aliases and fuzzy room terminology are used as a fallback. Ambiguous matches are refused.

data_description.area_match_areas: Only selected areas are considered. This is useful when similarly named rooms exist.
data_description.area_match_threshold: Higher values are more conservative. 90% is recommended.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Dahua ARC
reauth_confirm.description: Update the local Dahua ARC credentials for {host}.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Dahua ARC
reconfigure.description: Update the local connection details. The integration verifies the hub before saving and reloads automatically.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Dahua ARC hub.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the current password.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the ARC alarm hub.
error.serial_unavailable: The ARC did not report a serial number. Setup was stopped to avoid an unstable identity.
error.no_areas: No Home Assistant areas exist yet. Create at least one area or disable smart area matching.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while validating the ARC alarm hub.

abort.already_configured: This ARC alarm hub is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The hub at this address is a different ARC than the one this entry was set up with.

init.title: Dahua ARC options
init.description: Adjust reconciliation and smart area matching. Saving options reloads the integration.

data.auto_area_match: Smartly assign unassigned devices and sensors to Home Assistant areas

data_description.periodic_resync_seconds: 300 seconds is recommended for normal operation.
data_description.auto_area_match: When enabled, only entities without an explicit area are considered. Disabling this does not remove previous area assignments.
data_description.enable_research_features: Off by default. Enables the experimental PIRCam snapshot camera, LowRateWPAN polling/subscription diagnostics and PIRCam detector-test buttons. The detector-test buttons are the only feature that writes to the ARC (they toggle a PIR camera's sensitivity test). Leave disabled for production wired-zone operation.

area_match.title: Smart area matching
area_match.description: Choose eligible areas and the minimum confidence. Existing zone decisions are kept unless you choose to re-evaluate them, and manual Home Assistant area assignments are always preserved.

data.rematch_existing: Re-evaluate zones that already have a decision

data_description.area_match_threshold: Higher values are more conservative. 90% is recommended.
data_description.rematch_existing: Off keeps every stored decision and only matches newly discovered zones. On recomputes all zones with the settings above; the preview shows the result before anything is saved.

research_enabled.title: Dahua ARC research features are enabled

confirm.title: Disable Dahua ARC research features
confirm.description: Experimental PIRCam / LowRateWPAN research tools are enabled for this entry. They are not a reliable motion path, and the detector-test buttons write to the ARC. This will turn them off for this config entry and reload the integration. The stable wired-zone path remains enabled.

abort.entry_not_found: The Dahua ARC config entry no longer exists.

no_primary_zones.title: Dahua ARC exposed no primary alarm inputs
no_primary_zones.description: The integration connected to the ARC hub but did not identify any primary alarm inputs to expose. Check the ARC Alarm table, MultiIO pairing, firmware, and diagnostics before relying on the integration.

inventory_error.title: Dahua ARC extended inventory collection failed
inventory_error.description: The production input-state path may still work, but extended inventory collection reported: {error}

serial_mismatch.title: A different Dahua ARC answers at {host}
serial_mismatch.description: The ARC at {host} reports a different serial number than the one this integration entry was set up with, so it was not loaded to protect your existing entities and automations. If the hub moved to a new address, use **Reconfigure** to point the entry at the right address. If the ARC was replaced, add it as a new integration instead.
